newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Peruvian cement companies started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Peruvian cement companies started.

text.p: HSBC James Capel said Thursday it had started coverage of Peru's Cementos Lima and Cementos Norte Pacasmayo with ratings of buy and long-term buy, respectively.
-- The firm described Cementos Lima as "Peru's largest and most aggressive producer." It set a year-end 1998 price target equivalent to $26.90.
-- HSBC James Capel set an end-1998 price target equivalent to $1.70 for Cementos Norte Pacasmayo, the second-largest cement producer in Peru.
-- Cementos Norte Pacasmayo closed Wednesday at 3.80 soles in Lima. Cementos Lima closed at 54 soles.
